scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/js/main.ts --bundle --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/js/bundle.js && esbuild src/css/*.css src/js/plugins.js --minify --outbase=src --outdir=dist && mkdir -p dist/img && cp -R src/js/vendor dist/js/ && cp src/img/*.png dist/img/ && cp src/index.html src/404.html src/favicon.ico src/humans.txt src/robots.txt src/crossdomain.xml src/.htaccess dist/
